description: This file implements the MultiLogCTVerifier class for verifying Certificate Transparency SCTs, including logging and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: MultiLogCTVerifier
classes.description: Class responsible for verifying SCTs from multiple logs, managing log verifiers, and logging verification results.

classes.name: MultiLogCTVerifier::CTLogProvider
classes.description: Nested class providing callback registration and notification for log verifiers.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Main method to verify SCTs from a certificate, including embedded, OCSP, and TLS extension SCTs.

methods.name: VerifySCTs
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a list of SCTs from a given source.

methods.name: VerifySingleSCT
methods.description: Verifies an individual SCT against known logs and its signature.

methods.name: SetLogs
methods.description: Sets the list of log verifiers to be used for SCT verification.
